# Claude Pet — Full product reference

Canonical website: https://claude-pet.yeongyu.me/
Reference release: v0.24, published 2026-09-12T15:55:00Z (2026-09-13 00:55 KST).
Reference updated: 2026-09-13.

## Purpose

Claude Pet is a free desktop companion for macOS and Windows that displays Claude usage in a compact summary pill. It combines an animated character with usage percentages and reset times so users can check their allowance while working. It has public source on GitHub; source availability alone does not establish a software license.

## Platform capabilities

| Capability | macOS | Windows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| System | macOS 12 or later | Windows 10/11 |
| Architecture | Apple Silicon; Intel through universal build | x64 |
| Main download | ClaudePet.dmg or ClaudePet-universal.dmg | claude-pet-win-setup.exe |
| ZIP alternative | ClaudePet.zip or ClaudePet-universal.zip | claude-pet-win.zip |
| Signing | Developer ID signed and Apple-notarized | Unsigned; security warnings may appear |
| Claude Code credential | Keychain or ~/.claude/.credentials.json | %USERPROFILE%/.claude/.credentials.json |
| Updates | Hourly checks after launch; in-app installation from right-click menu | Right-click check opens releases for newer installer download |
| Custom pets | ~/.claude_pet/pets | %USERPROFILE%/.claude_pet/pets |
| Start at login | Configure in macOS Login Items | Optional installer setting |
| Uninstall | Right-click → Uninstall completely… | Settings → Apps for installer version |

Python is bundled with the packaged applications. Neither platform requires a separate Python installation for these downloads.

## Installation: macOS

1. Sign in to Claude Code on the Mac.
2. Download ClaudePet.dmg for Apple Silicon or ClaudePet-universal.dmg for Intel from GitHub Releases.
3. Open the DMG and drag ClaudePet.app to Applications. Launch the app.
4. When prompted, allow access to the existing Claude Code credential and usage logs. A credential file may be used instead of Keychain on some installations.
5. Right-click the companion to adjust settings, pet selection, size and roaming.

ZIP installation is also available: extract the appropriate ZIP and move ClaudePet.app to Applications.

## Installation: Windows

1. Sign in to Claude Code on Windows. The app uses the credential stored in %USERPROFILE%/.claude/.credentials.json.
2. For installation, run claude-pet-win-setup.exe. It installs per user, adds a Start Menu entry and offers optional start at sign-in.
3. Alternatively, extract claude-pet-win.zip and run ClaudePet/ClaudePet.exe from the extracted folder.
4. Windows builds are unsigned. SmartScreen or another warning may appear depending on Windows settings and organizational policies. Download from the project's GitHub release and review the file before running it. Do not promise that warnings appear only once or that every system permits execution.
5. Right-click the pet to configure it.

## Usage data and interpretation

Exact mode requests Anthropic's server-computed account usage percentages and reset times using the existing Claude Code OAuth credential. macOS reads Keychain or the Claude Code credentials file; Windows reads the credentials file. Usage categories, such as session, weekly, model or credits, depend on what Anthropic returns for that account.

Local fallback estimates usage from Claude Code records under ~/.claude, under the Windows user profile on Windows. Web and desktop chat activity absent from those records is not counted. Optional calibration uses the percentage from Claude Settings → Usage to adjust the local estimate. This does not alter server-computed percentages. An estimate is not a guarantee of remaining token allowance.

In v0.24 the display is a compact summary pill, with percentages and a second line of reset times when available. Number color identifies source: server usage is emerald, estimated usage is amber and marked ≈, and API cost uses coral. Labels reflect utilization: white below 50%, yellow from 50%, red from 85%; surge detection can also show a red label and ▲. An expired-token fallback may show ⚠. Do not confuse data-source colors with utilization thresholds.

The website's interactive pill is a labeled illustration using fixed example values. It does not read the visitor's account and is not a screenshot of the running application.

## Companion behavior and customization

The cat is built in; dog, fox, scorpion and elephant are bundled. Switch pets through the right-click menu. Users may add compatible pet.json and sprite-sheet folders under ~/.claude_pet/pets (Mac) or %USERPROFILE%/.claude_pet/pets (Windows).

Roaming can be enabled or disabled. The companion can wander, follow the cursor at a distance and move between monitors. The summary pill tucks away while the pet moves. Users can drag the pet, resize it and adjust display settings. Double-clicking jumps and refreshes usage; the companion reacts to a detected session reset. Interface languages include English, Korean, Japanese and Spanish.

## Updates

macOS checks GitHub hourly, beginning one hour after launch. The right-click menu also offers an immediate check and installation of a newer release. Installation downloads, replaces and relaunches the app.

Windows provides an update check in the right-click menu. If a newer version is available, the flow opens the latest GitHub Releases page so the user can download the new installer. Do not apply the macOS hourly timer or automatic in-app replacement description to Windows.

## Privacy and optional Admin API mode

Usage log parsing happens locally on the user's computer. Exact mode sends the existing Claude Code credential to Anthropic to request account usage. Update checking and downloading contact GitHub. Those usage and update paths do not upload prompts, transcripts or source code. The app also reads its settings, assets and installed resources; it is not an offline-only program.

The website at claude-pet.yeongyu.me is separate from the app. It runs Google Analytics 4 on every page to count visits; measurement is not optional there. The app never contacts the website or Google.

Optional Admin API mode reports Anthropic Console organization costs and a configured budget. This is separate from Claude subscription limits. A configured Admin API key is stored in plaintext in ~/.claude_pet.json, under the user profile on Windows.

## Scope and independence

This release monitors Claude, not other AI services. Claude Pet is an independent project by Yeongyu Yang (GitHub: uygnoey). It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic PBC. Claude is a trademark of Anthropic PBC.

## 한국어 안내

Claude Pet은 macOS와 Windows에서 Claude 사용량을 확인하는 무료 데스크톱 펫입니다. macOS 12 이상과 Windows 10/11 x64를 지원합니다. Mac은 Apple Silicon용과 Intel universal 빌드가 있고, Windows는 설치 파일과 무설치 ZIP을 제공합니다. Windows 배포본은 서명이 없어 보안 경고가 나타날 수 있습니다.

정확 모드는 기존 Claude Code 인증 정보로 Anthropic의 계정 사용률과 리셋 시간을 요청합니다. Mac에서는 키체인 또는 자격 증명 파일, Windows에서는 %USERPROFILE%/.claude/.credentials.json을 읽습니다. 로컬 대체 모드는 Claude Code 로그만 추정하며 기록되지 않은 웹·데스크톱 사용량은 포함하지 못합니다.

Mac은 실행 후 1시간마다 업데이트를 확인하고 앱 안에서 설치할 수 있습니다. Windows는 우클릭 메뉴에서 확인한 뒤 GitHub Releases에서 새 설치 파일을 다운로드합니다. 사용량 표시, 화면 산책, 펫 선택은 두 플랫폼에서 제공하며, 다른 AI 서비스는 현재 지원 범위에 포함하지 않습니다.
